Specifically, SOP IG_MSP-000532_ING version 20.0 describes the process for receipt, management, and investigation of customer product quality complaints. Your firm’s handling of customer product quality complaints investigation is deficient in that it does not require practice of testing retention samples of respective lots for most frequent complaints. Since 2021, your firm has received US customer product quality complaints for Fibrin Sealant [VistaSeal] categorized as biologics thawing issue as follows: 2021, 46 complaints; 2022, 31 complaints; and 2023 (Q3), 14 complaints. For example, review of selected biologics thawing issue complaint investigations 800010433, 800010845, 800010963, 800011603, and 800011859 revealed that none of the complaints investigated were supported by testing the retention samples. There is no documented evidence that your firm retention samples were tested as part of the complaint investigation for biologics thawing issue.
